records.jp: 何かが足りない、そう思ったことはないかね
records.en_original: Have you ever felt like something was...missing?
records.en: Have you ever thought something was missing?

records.jp: ……また何か変なことを始めるつもり？
records.en_original: Is this the beginning of another one of your shenanigans?
records.en: ...Are you planning to start something weird again?

records.jp: ただあたしはキミたちに聞きたいのだ。<CR>今の生活に不足感を覚えているのではないか、と
records.en_original: I'm just asking if anyone's ever felt like there was something missing from their life.
records.en: I'm just asking you all:<CR>don't you feel like something's missing from our lives?

records.jp: いや、そんな抽象的に聞かれたって……
records.en_original: That's quite the difficult question...
records.en: That’s too abstract a question...

records.jp: いい？　この学校に足りないのは――そう！
records.en_original: Listen up, I'll tell you all exactly what this school is missing!
records.en: Listen. What this school lacks is—yes!

records.jp: 観光名所だよ！！
records.en_original: Some new activities!
records.en: A tourist attraction!!

records.jp: は？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: ん？
records.en_original: Hmm?
records.en: Hmm?

records.jp: お？
records.en_original: Oh?
records.en: Oh?

records.jp: 学校魔改造計画で賑わってきているけど、<CR>まだまだインパクトが足りないと思うんだよね
records.en_original: We've made some good improvements with the Extreme School Makeover Planning Committee, but it's still lacking some impact.
records.en: The Extreme School Makeover Project has livened things up,<CR>but I still think it lacks impact.

records.jp: ここらでドカーンと盛大に遊べる場所、<CR>つまりは観光名所が必要だと思わんかね！！
records.en_original: We need something with some real oomph!
records.en: Don't you think we need somewhere we can really cut loose—<CR>a proper tourist attraction?!

records.jp: かなり私情だね
records.en_original: Seems like your problem.
records.en: That’s a very personal motive.

records.jp: ん～？　そんな態度でいいのこころ？<CR>わが軍につけば……ドーナツを支給します
records.en_original: Hmmm? Are you sure you wanna say that Kokoro? People on my team...all get donuts!
records.en: Hmm? Is that any way to respond, Kokoro?<CR>Join my army, and you shall receive donuts.

records.jp: 勇希ちゃんの言う通りなのです！！
records.en_original: I agree with Yuki!
records.en: Yuki-chan is absolutely right!

records.jp: こころ！？
records.en_original: Kokoro?!
records.en: Kokoro?!

records.jp: ふははははは！！　これで二対二！<CR>さらに愛央！
records.en_original: Hahaha! Now it's two against two! You're next, Ao!
records.en: Fwahahaha! Now it’s two against two!<CR>And next, Ao!

records.jp: くっ、私はこころのようにはいかんぞ！
records.en_original: Ngh, I won't fall for your tricks like Kokoro!
records.en: Ngh, I won’t be won over like Kokoro!

records.jp: キミにはこの一大プロジェクトの<CR>リーダーをやってもらおうと思うのだが
records.en_original: I'd like you to be the leader of this most important of projects.
records.en: I was thinking you could be<CR>the leader of this grand project.

records.jp: わ、私が……プロジェクトのリーダー……？
records.en_original: The leader... M-me?
records.en: The leader... M-me?

records.jp: 落ち着いて星崎さん。<CR>言葉の響きに騙されないで
records.en_original: Calm down, Hoshizaki. Don't be tempted by the nice-sounding title.
records.en: Calm down, Hoshizaki-san.<CR>Don’t be fooled by how impressive the title sounds.

records.jp: 任せてください！<CR>私がここを立派な観光地にして見せます！！
records.en_original: Leave it to me! We'll build the best this world has ever seen!
records.en: Leave it to me!<CR>I’ll turn this place into a magnificent tourist destination!

records.jp: だめだチョロ過ぎる
records.en_original: I see it's too late.
records.en: No, she's way too easy to win over.

records.jp: はぁ～、もうわかったわかった。<CR>私も賛成で
records.en_original: *Sigh*... Fine, I'm on board as well.
records.en: Sigh... Fine, fine.<CR>I’m in too.

records.jp: ぃやったーー！！
records.en_original: Yessss!
records.en: Yaaay!!

records.jp: それで、具体的にはどうするのプロジェクトリーダー
records.en_original: So, what is the plan exactly, miss leader?
records.en: So what exactly are we doing, Project Leader?

records.jp: 観光名所って言っても色々なタイプがあるよね。<CR>皆は何か作ってみたいものとかってある？
records.en_original: There are lots of different ways we could do this. Does anyone have something they want to make?
records.en: Tourist attractions come in all kinds.<CR>Does anyone have something they’d like to make?

records.jp: あたしはナイトプール！<CR>ナイトなプールが作りたい！！
records.en_original: I want a night pool! A pool, but for nighttime!
records.en: I want a night pool!<CR>A pool, but for nighttime!!

records.jp: 打ち上げ花火なんてどうかな？<CR>おいしそうだし観光名所に向いてると思うのです！
records.en_original: How about some fireworks? Those always look so yummy.
records.en: How about launching fireworks?<CR>They look delicious and would make a good tourist attraction!

records.jp: どうせなら普段体験できないようなものがいいし、<CR>気球とか？
records.en_original: It should be something that we've never done before. A hot-air balloon or something?
records.en: If we’re doing this, it should be something we can’t normally experience.<CR>How about a hot-air balloon?

records.jp: （ナイトプールに打ち上げ花火、気球……<CR>どれを作っても観光名所にはなりそう）
records.en_original: (A night pool, fireworks, a hot-air balloon... They're all great ideas.)
records.en: (A night pool, fireworks, a hot-air balloon...<CR>Any of them could become a tourist attraction.)

records.jp: どうですか愛央プロジェクトリーダー！<CR>どの案を採用しますか！？
records.en_original: What do you think, leader?! Which one are we doing?!
records.en: What do you think, Project Leader Ao?<CR>Which proposal will you choose?!

records.jp: （でも、せっかくなら――）
records.en_original: (We don't get this chance very often...)
records.en: (But if we’re going to do this—)

records.jp: ――全部だ
records.en_original: All of them!
records.en: —All of them.

records.jp: ほえ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 全部作ってこの学校を最強の観光名所にする……
records.en_original: We're gonna make all of them and make the best activities this school has ever seen!
records.en: We’ll make all of them and turn this school into the ultimate tourist attraction...

records.jp: それこそが学校魔改造計画プロジェクトΔ！！
records.en_original: The name of our mission? Extreme School Makeover Planning Committee: Project Delta!
records.en: That's Extreme School Makeover Project Delta!!

records.jp: また面倒なことを……<CR>まぁ、楽しそうだけど
records.en_original: It never ends... Though, it does sound like fun.
records.en: More trouble...<CR>Though it does sound fun.

records.jp: それじゃあ、プロジェクト、始動！！
records.en_original: Let the project commence!
records.en: Let the project commence!

records.jp: おー！！
records.en_original: Yeah!!
records.en: Yeah!!

records.jp: 「<CLGR>？ナイトなプール？<CLNR>」が<CR>開発可能になりました
records.en_original: <CLGR>Swimming at Night?<CLNR> can now be developed.
records.en: <CLGR>A Nighttime Pool?<CLNR><CR>can now be developed.

records.jp: 「<CLGR>？夏空に咲くドーナツ？<CLNR>」が<CR>開発可能になりました
records.en_original: <CLGR>Explosions in the Sky?<CLNR> can now be developed.
records.en: <CLGR>Donuts Blooming in the Summer Sky?<CLNR><CR>can now be developed.

records.jp: 「<CLGR>？青空遊覧体験？<CLNR>」が<CR>開発可能になりました
records.en_original: <CLGR>Sightseeing from Above?<CLNR> can now be developed.
records.en: <CLGR>A Blue-Sky Sightseeing Experience?<CLNR><CR>can now be developed.
